maildir.description: Default directory for mailboxes. Used for expanding relative paths or '+' prefix.

mailboxes.description: List of mailboxes to check. Use '!' for inbox, absolute paths, or paths relative to maildir. If empty, defaults to checking defined mailboxes or aborting if none are set in file logic (though logic is handled by app, this configures the list). Note: The man page says if no args and no file, it aborts. This file IS the config. So this list defines what to check if no CLI args passed, or it can be used by wrappers. Actually, lsmbox reads this file if no args. So this list IS the default set of mailboxes to monitor.

mailboxes.items.description: A single mailbox specification. Can be '!' (inbox), '+subdir', '=inbox', or a path.

new_only.description: If true, only show mailboxes with new messages.

no_old.description: If true, do not show old (read) message counts.

no_total.description: If true, do not show total message counts.

no_summary.description: If true, do not show the summary line.

short_names.description: If true, show short mailbox names instead of full paths.

padding.description: Width of the mailbox column. Empty string means auto-size.

continuous.description: If true, run in continuous update mode (-c).

check_interval.description: Check interval in seconds for continuous mode.
